description: A PHP class named Mail that provides basic email sending functionalities, including setting recipients, sender, subject, message content (plain text and HTML), and handling the sending process with headers and attachments.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Provides methods to compose and send emails, including setting recipients, subject, message content, and handling multipart email formats with optional attachments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Mail object with optional configuration options.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient(s) of the email.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender's display name or email.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text message body.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Compiles the email headers and message and attempts to send the email using the PHP mail() function, handling multipart content and attachments.
